Leukaemias, acute. The acute leukaemias are malig- nancies affecting haematopoietic precursor cells. They are relatively rare (about 1 to 3 cases per 100 000 of popula- tion), and of uncertain cause in the majority of cases, al- though radiation, carcinogenic substances, or oncogenic retroviruses have been implicated in some types, and cer- tain individuals appear to have a genetic predisposition to these diseases.
